content.comment_body: Hello everyone, thank you in advance. I added a Modbus server connection to the network project, but now I can't remove it. When working in diagram mode, I can use 'tools-ethernet connections' to delete it, but in network project this option is unavailable. Can anyone guide me on how to delete this connection?
Hello [user_name], Please see the attached video. Select the connection line and press the 'delete' button.
Thank you for your response. I managed to delete the connection, but not with the delete key—instead, I used the backspace key. I'm unsure why, but it worked. Thanks again.
I tested the backspace key, and it worked for me as well.

analysis.insight_summary: Users ran into difficulty when trying to delete Modbus server connections within the network project feature, since expected deletion options were disabled and the interface wasn't clear. There was inconsistency in key functions, as the delete key didn't work, but the backspace key could be used to remove the connection. This led to confusion and extra time spent resolving the issue, until a user clarified the workaround.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipated a straightforward and consistent way to delete Modbus connections in the network project, ideally matching the diagram mode functionality.
